Kelly Ayotte

Republican candidate for Governor, New Hampshire · Incumbent

Governor of New Hampshire

Kelly Ayotte is a Republican from Nashua who has served as Governor of New Hampshire since 2025. She filed for reelection at the Secretary of State's office on June 4, 2026, and is seeking a second two-year term. In the November 3, 2026 general election she faces Democrat Cinde Warmington and Libertarian Stephen Villee.

Background

  • Governor of New Hampshire, 2025–present
  • Won the 2024 gubernatorial election by about 9.3 percentage points
  • Filed for reelection June 4, 2026
